note: A spec entry is a PROMISE THAT SOMETHING APPEARS ON A SCREEN. verify-declared-is-rendered.mjs proves each promised id/element is actually referenced by the component chain that draws it. Adding a spec entry without wiring the renderer FAILS. This file may grow; the waiver list may only shrink.

contracts.why: C25-C31 were declared in the spec, a guard proved they were declared, and no component ever drew them. Owner looked for months.
TXH-01 specified a two-pane wiring map. A flat table shipped. The block was scored on its backend contract; nothing asserted the screen.
